comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus index a Geneva drive and prove its dwell.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine setting adjustment and locking plus impact trials versus driving a contact mechanism through indexing cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Two non-bottoming retained-response cycles versus two valid advances with stationary dwell after release.
comparison.reason: Repeated cycles are generic; one tests tunable energy absorption, the other intermittent kinematics and dwell. Exact indexing thresholds are omitted and specs are empty.
